# You Know My Name

Journal: `ep1/quests/main_quest/q303_songbird` · `MainQuest` · hash `1967265692`.

Journal premise: Nothing’s impossible, huh? Not only you managed to get Mr. Hands to help you, but even got old Solomon Reed to confide in you. You’re on a hot streak, V – it seems that even breaking into the best-guarded fortress in Dogtown (maybe even all of Night City) is actually possible. And if you do manage to get Songbird out of there, you should consider buying a bunch of scratch tickets, ‘cause Lady Luck is clearly on your side.

## Required acceptance cases before reuse

Exercise normal completion and each named alternate outcome; interrupt and return at every scene handoff; start with spatial/item/actor predicates already satisfied; save/load across waits and joins; cancel parallel listeners; verify reward delivery once; and verify cleanup without changing the committed outcome. Apply the block-specific cases in the [expanded contracts](../all-quest-blocks.md). No installed playtest is claimed.
